subject: english
stem: The next message is for students and families. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up photo hall
photos are not allowed anywhere during River Clean-up
photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up workshop

optionRationales.reason: photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up photo hall：此項把「workshop」改成「photo hall」。音稿明確陳述「photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up workshop」。因此，鎖定證據支持「photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up workshop」。

photos are not allowed anywhere during River Clean-up：此項把「in the River Clean-up workshop」改成「anywhere during River Clean-up」。音稿明確陳述「photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up workshop」。因此，鎖定證據支持「photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up workshop」。
photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up workshop：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up workshop」。

photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up model room：此項把「workshop」改成「model room」。音稿明確陳述「photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up workshop」。因此，鎖定證據支持「photos are not allowed in the River Clean-up workshop」。
